verses.text: From Paul, an apostle. I was not sent by people, or through any person. I was sent by Jesus Christ, and by God the Father, who raised him from the dead.
All the brothers and sisters with me join me. I write to the churches in Galatia.
Grace and peace to you from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ.
He gave himself for our sins, to rescue us from this present evil age. This was the will of our God and Father.
To him be the glory for ever and ever. Amen.
I am amazed that you are so quickly turning away from God, who called you by the grace of Christ. You are turning to a different "good news".
But there is no other good news. Some people are troubling you. They want to twist the Good News of Christ.
But if we, or even an angel from heaven, preach to you a good news different from the one we preached, let him be cursed.
We said it before, and now I say it again. If anyone preaches to you a good news different from the one you received, let him be cursed.
Am I now trying to win the approval of people, or of God? Am I trying to please people? If I were still pleasing people, I would not be a servant of Christ.
Brothers and sisters, I want you to know that the Good News I preached did not come from people.
I did not receive it from any person, and no one taught it to me. Jesus Christ showed it to me.
You have heard how I used to live in the Jewish religion. I attacked God's church terribly and tried to destroy it.
I was going further in the Jewish religion than many people of my own age. I was very keen on the traditions of my ancestors.
But God chose me before I was born, and called me by his grace. When it pleased him,
he showed his Son to me, so that I would preach him among the Gentiles. I did not rush to ask any person for advice.
I did not go up to Jerusalem to see those who were apostles before me. Instead, I went away into Arabia, and later I returned to Damascus.
Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter. I stayed with him for fifteen days.
I saw none of the other apostles, except James, the Lord's brother.
I tell you before God that what I write to you is not a lie.
Then I went to the areas of Syria and Cilicia.
The churches of Christ in Judea did not know me by face.
They only heard people say, "The man who once attacked us now preaches the faith he once tried to destroy."
And they praised God because of me.
